spans.s: Nimesha^1, a Nāga(?), accord. to Nīl., a Yaksha. § 46 (Garuḍa): I, 32, 1489 (fought with Garuḍa).

Nimi^1, an ancient king of the Videhas. § 6 (Anukram.): I, 1, 227 (in Sañjaya's enumeration).--§ 267 (Yamasabhāv.): II, 8, 320 (in the palace of Yama).--§ 677 (Mokshadh.): XII, 235, 8600 (Vaidehaḥ, gave his kingdom to the brahmans).--§ 761 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 115, 5667 (among the kings who did not eat meat during the month of Kārttika). --§ 767 (do.): XIII, 137, 6255 (gave his kingdom [to the brahmans], cf. XII, 8600; PCR. is wrong in connecting Vaidarbhiḥ with Nimiḥ).--§ 775 (do.): XIII, 166, 7681 (rājā, enumeration). Cf. Vaideha.
Nimi^2, son of Dattātreya and father of Śrīmat. § 749 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 91, 4330 (Dattātreyasya putraḥ, father of Śrīmat), 4332, 4345 (was the first who performed a śrāddha), 92, 4372.
Nimisha^1, a Suparṇa, son of Garuḍa. § 564 (Mātalīyop.): V, 101, 3595 (enumeration).
Nimnagāsuta (“son of the river”) = Bhīshma: XIII, 7723.
